theorem norm_S_eta2_le_of_not_mem {α y n w G : ℝ} (hy0 : 0 < y) (hα : α ∉ majorArcs 8 n y)
    (hw0 : 0 < w) (hz : 2.16e20 ≤ w * y) (hlow : 670 ≤ min 1 w * n)
    (hG1 : min 1 w * n ≤ (w * y) ^ (1 / 3 : ℝ) / 6 → gx (w * y) (min 1 w * n) ≤ G)
    (hG2 : 0.276 * (w * y) ^ (5 / 6 : ℝ) * Real.log (w * y) ^ (3 / 2 : ℝ) +
      1234 * (w * y) ^ (2 / 3 : ℝ) * Real.log (w * y) ≤ G * (w * y)) :
    ‖S eta2 (w * y) α‖ ≤ G * (w * y) :=

note: The first case holds in Lean with 0.8764, 2.526 and 3.8x^{5/6} in place of 0.5, 2.5 and 3.36x^{5/6}; 2.526 comes from c₀ = 32 and Lean's ψ(V) ≤ 1.0064V (book 1.0004). Erratum: In (6.77) [H] prints the AM-GM constant as (1/2)(log2/√ρ+(√ρ/2)·0.67506) = 0.49911 (stated as 0.5); the correct value is 0.81020, so [H]'s own (6.63) exceeds (3.2) by up to 2.65% for prime q and 3.19% at q = 60060. (checked by `scripts/checks/theorem_3_1_1.py`).
